question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The erroneous spelling is** "Fullfil".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The incorrectly spelled word is Fullfil and the correct spelling is "Fulfill".
 
• The word **'Fulfill'** means 'to make something that you wish for happen; to achieve a goal'.(अभीष्‍ट काम को पूरा करना; लक्ष्‍य की प्राप्ति करना)
